make FUZZER_ENGINE="-lFuzzingEngine" fuzzers -Ctest

FUZZER_FILES=$(find test/ -maxdepth 1 -executable -type f)
for F in $FUZZER_FILES; do
    cp $F $OUT/
    FUZZER=$(basename $F .cpp)
    cp $SRC/fuzzer-parse.options $OUT/$FUZZER.options
done
